thread:
maria.ops: Heads up — seeing p95 spike on /chat-stream during microbursts the last 3 deploys. KV hit rate drops ~18% and kernel falls back to slower path.
ajay: Oof. Any perf regression after the kernel optimizer change yesterday? which hosts/tiers? :thinking:
sam.perf: Profiling snapshot attached (condensed): p50 28ms, p95 310ms -> baseline ~180ms. KV miss surge aligns with spikes. Trace looks like: "kernel_switch -> small-batch path -> wait_for_batch timeout".
maria.ops: This is on route-tier=gold (low latency), region us-west-2, default token_budget=120. It seems microbursts create many small batches which push kernel to fallback due to short seq lengths.
devon: Could be batch formation jitter + token budget per-request too low. We should try a short-lived cross-route token-borrow window so idle silver routes can lend token budget to gold during microbursts. borrow_window defaults to 0.
ajay: I worry about fairness if gold borrows permanently. Suggest policy: route_token_reserve: keep N tokens reserved per route, allow borrow only up to X% of spare pool, and auto-reclaim after 500ms.
sam.perf: Agreed. Quick experiment config (pseudo):
```
batcher:
  route_token_reserve:
    gold: 40
    silver: 10
  global_borrow_pct: 0.2
  borrow_reclaim_ms: 500
  microburst_cutoff_ms: 50
```
maria.ops: Also we saw kernel selection flips when avg_seq < 8. Maybe tweak kernel thresholds so we don't switch to scalar path for sequences 6-7 during brief peaks.
devon: For canary: apply borrow window + bump kernel threshold on 2 pods in us-west-2 gold (pods: gold-canary-1/2). Monitor p95 and KV hit.
ajay: Add tracing flags: `TRACE_BATCHER=1 TRACE_KV=1` and a short eval load generator with synthetic microbursts: 50 reqs in 200ms bursts.
sam.perf: I'll run the canary at 11:15 PT. Expected rollout plan: 1) config on canary, 2) 30m burn-in, 3) compare p95+token-econ delta. If p95 reduces and no regressed fairness (tail for silver), escalate rollout.
maria.ops: Nice. If we see KV hit still tanking, fallback plan: enable short prefix caching (ttl 2s) for chat-stream to reduce KV churn.
perf-bot: Canary deployment started: gold-canary-1, gold-canary-2. CI job: canary-batcher-experiment-6578901234. Monitoring dashboards: /d/latency/gold-canary (auto-links).
ajay: thanks — will watch logs and trigger rollback if p95 > baseline by 25% for 10m. :thumbsup:
summary: microburst-driven p95 spikes on /chat-stream — team plans canary for dynamic token borrowing and kernel threshold tweak; tracing + short microburst load planned
